Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১) ‘I am working on a book about the parts of speech - that's right, nouns, verbs, _______ and all the rest.’
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: In English the main parts of speech are noun, pronoun, adjective, verb, adverb, preposition, conjunction, and interjection.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question:
২) In the following sentence which is a determiner?
Bring your children with you.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Words like my, our, your, his, her, its, and their are known as possessive determiners. They come before nouns and indicate ownership of the noun in question, as their name suggests:
My leg hurts.
James sold his business.
Bring your children with you.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩) Although southern california is densely populated, _______ live in the northern part of the state.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: People শব্দটি plural countable noun, তাই এর পূর্বে Determiner হিসেবে few বা many দুইটিই বসতে পারে। কিন্তু বাক্যের অর্থ ঠিক রাখতে এখানে few বসবে। অর্থাৎ শূন্যস্থানে only a few people বসবে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪) ‘A preposition’ is a _______.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: যে Word কোন Noun বা Pronoun এর পূর্বে বসে Sentence এর অন্য কোন Word এর সাথে সম্পর্ক স্থাপন করে তাকে Preposition বলে ।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৫) Strong and aggressive, he is not averse _____ a bit of shirt pulling and uses his arms effectively to hold off defenders.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Averse from/to বিমুখ; পরাঙ্মুখ; বিরোধী; অনিচ্ছুক।
I am not averse to hard work.
They are averse from taking tough measures.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৬) ___________ is currently available to researchers & physicians who study the indigenous life of Bangladesh.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Information শব্দটি uncountable noun, তাই এর পূর্বে little/a little বসবে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৭) The train is _______ to leave the station.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Be about to do something (PHRASE)
Intend to do something, or be close to doing something, very soon.
The ceremony was about to begin.
The train is about to leave the station.
I was about to climb into bed when the bell rang.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৮) He was only a yard ______ me.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
সাধারণত উৎস বা নেতিবাচক অবস্থান বুঝাতে off ব্যবহৃত হয়।
He was only a yard off me.
অর্থাৎ সে আমার থেকে মাত্র এক গজ দূরে ছিল।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৯) ______ of what he said was very sensible.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: “what he said” uncountable noun, তাই শূন্যস্থানে much বসবে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১০) The walls of our house have been painted ______ green. Which of the correct prepositions is in the blank above?
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Paint (verb) to cover a surface with paint:
We've painted the bedroom blue.
I've been painting all morning.
They had painted the walls white.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১১) This is ______ heroic action.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Heroic [হেরোউইক্‌] (adjective) বীরোচিত; বীরত্বপূর্ণ; পরাক্রান্ত; সাহসিক।
H এর উচ্চারণ 'হ' এর মতো হয়েছে। তাই Heroic শব্দটির পূর্বে Article ''A'' বসবে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১২) Please leave your key _______ reception.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: ছোট স্থান বা জায়গার নামের পূর্বে at বসে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৩) I see you are ______ Wordsworth.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: সাধারণত proper noun এর পূর্বে A/An বসে না। কিন্তু ‘একজন’ বা ‘জনৈক’ বুঝাতে proper noun এর পূর্বে A/An বসতে পারে। আবার অপরিচিত ব্যক্তির নাম বা পদবীর আগেও A/An বসতে পারে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৪) Bangladesh was liberated ______ 1971.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
মাস, ঋতু, বছর, দশক, শতাব্দী ইত্যাদির পূর্বে in বসে।
I was born in June.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৫) George _____ the sixth was ______ king of England.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর অপশন খ) no article, the.
যখন কোন ordinal number অক্ষর দ্বারা লেখা হয় তখন তার পূর্বে the বসে। প্রশ্নে the লিখা আছে, তাই প্রথম শূন্যস্থানে no article হবে। অর্থাৎ কোন কিছু বসবে না। আর king of England এর পূর্বে the বসবে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৬) The people grew impatient _______ the burden of heavy taxation.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Under (preposition)
(১) নিচে; তলে; নিম্নে; তল/নিচ দিয়ে: The workers were gossiping under the factory wall.
(২) ভিতরে আচ্ছাদিত; তলে; নিচে: The child hid his face under the bedclothes.
(৩) চেয়ে ন্যূনতর; নিচের; নিম্নপদস্থ; children under (বিপরীত over/above) fifteen years of age, পনের বছরের কম বয়সের: books for the under tens (বিপরীত over-tens); speak under one’s breath, ফিসফিস করে কথা বলা।
(৪) (বিভিন্ন অবস্থাসূচক): under discussion, আলোচ্য; বক্ষ্যমাণ: road under repair, সংস্কারাধীন; under sentence of death, মৃত্যুদণ্ডাদেশপ্রাপ্ত; India under the Mughals, মোগল শাসনাধীন; twenty acres under rice, ধান্যরোপিত বিশ একর; be under the impression that..., ধারণা/বিশ্বাস থাকা; living under an assumed name, ছদ্মনামে জীবনযাপন করা।
(৫) (সাহিত্যিক ও লাক্ষণিক) কোনোকিছুর ভারে অবনমিত: marching under a heavy load; sink under a load of greif, দুঃখের চাপে নুয়ে পড়া।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৭) Dr. Mary Edwards Walker was a surgeon, soldier _____ fighter for women’s rights.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: একই ধরনের একাধিক শব্দ যোগ করতে and ব্যবহার করা হয়। প্রশ্নে surgeon, soldier এবং fighter তিনটি শব্দই noun, তাই শূন্যস্থানে and বসবে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৮) Many poor people live ______ the island.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: দিক নির্ণয়ের ক্ষেত্রে সীমার ভিতরে অর্থে in; সীমার উপর বা বরাবর অর্থে on এবং সীমার বাইরে অর্থে to বসে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ১৯) This is the way ______ he talks.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
As (conjunction) (রীতিসূচক ক্রিয়াবিশেষণীয় অনুবাক্যের শুরুতে) যেমন....তেমন, যেভাবে ...সেভাবে।
He did as I said.
Bring it as it is.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২০) The dog could not find the cat because it hid _____ grass.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
কোন দিকে গতি বুঝাতে to, ভিতরে স্থিতি বুঝাতে in এবং ভিতরের দিকে গতি বুঝাতে into ব্যবহৃত হয়।
Sujon is going to college.
He is hiding in the jungle.
The dog jumped into the pond.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২১) Stay on the bus ______ Birmingham, and then change for London.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Till/until (preposition(al)) পর্যন্ত; অবধি।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২২) Which is known as the definite article?
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
The
[consonant- এর পূর্বে 'দা'; vowel- এর পূর্বে 'দি']
(definite article)
(১) পূর্বোক্ত ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুকে নির্দেশ করার জন্য ব্যবহার: A man had a cow. One day the man took the cow to the market to sell it.
(২) নির্দিষ্ট করে বোঝাতে অথবা যখন উল্লেখিত বস্তুটি বা ব্যক্তিটি খুবই পরিচিত: Take this letter to the post office (ভাকঘরটি কোথায় বা কোন ডাকঘরটি তা জানা): Please close the window, যে জানালাটি খোলা তা বন্ধ করো (ঘরে একটি জানালাই আছে, এমন ক্ষেত্রে হতে পারে)।
(৩) এমন noun- এর পূর্বে যা একক ও অনন্য: the sun, the moon, the universe, the year 2015 ইত্যাদি।
(৪) (ক) সমুদ্র বা মহাসাগরের নামের আগে: the Arabian sea. the Pacific ocean.
(খ) নদীর নামের আগে: the Meghna.
(গ) ভৌগোলিক নামের আগে: the Himalayas; the Punjab.
(৫) কোনো শ্রেণি বা গোত্রের সবাইকে বোঝাতে: the rich; the poor; the young; the dying; the dead.
(৬) প্রাণী বা উদ্ভিদের কোনো শ্রেণির সবাইকে বোঝাতে: The tiger is a ferocious animal.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৩) A mob bent _____ violence.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Bent on- কোনো উদ্দেশ্য সাধনে দৃঢ়সংকল্প হওয়া।
He is bent on success at any cost.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৪) All _______ a sudden, one day the police showed up and caught them _____ the act and arrested them.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
All of a sudden (হঠাৎ) একটা Phrase.
Caught in the act (idiom): caught while doing something specified.
He tried to rob a bank and was caught in the act.
Source: Bangla Academy Dictionary, Merriam-Webster Dictionary & Cliffs TOEFL.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৫) He said nothing _____ a long time.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
For + period: a ''period'' is a duration of time - five minutes, two weeks, six years, a long time.
For means ''from the beginning of the period to the end of the period''.
Since + point: a ''point'' is a precise moment in time - 9 o'clock, 1st January, Monday.
Since means ''from a point in the past until now''.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৬) The president was killed _____ a falling tree.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: কোন কিছু কোন agent (ব্যক্তি বা প্রাণী) ও method (পদ্ধতি) দ্বারা করা বা হওয়া বুঝালে by এবং tool (বস্তু) দ্বারা করা বা হওয়া বুঝেলে with ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৭) Scarcely had he come ________ it started raining.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
No sooner had - than , scarcely had – when , hardly had – before এর প্রথম অংশ Past Perfect and Verb এর Past Participle হয় এবং ২য় অংশে Past Indefinite হয়। যেমনঃ
No sooner had we reached the station than the train left,
Hardly had the train stopped before we got down,
Scarcely had we started when it began to rain.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৮) ______ giving me books, he prepared notes for me.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Besides: in addition to; also.
She won't mind if you're late - besides, it's hardly your fault.
Do you play any other sports besides basketball?
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ২৯) I spent hours poring _____ cookery books.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Pore over something: অভিনিবেশ সহকারে/নিবিষ্টভাবে/অনন্যচিত্তে পড়া/অধ্যয়ন করা।
Pore over a book/letter.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩০) Show your tiket, ________ you will not be allowed to enter.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Otherwise (conjunction) নয়তো; অথবা।
You must not hurry the work, otherwise it may be spoiled.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩১) The man is blind _______ one eye.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
চোখে না দেখার ক্ষেত্রে 'Blind of' ও দোষ না দেখার ক্ষেত্রে 'Blind to' বসে।
- He is blind of his eyes.
- Mr. Sikder is blind to his son’s fault.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩২) ________ you get father’s permission I will take you fishing next week.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: শর্ত বুঝাতে Provided/Provided that (যদি) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৩) The following day government prosecutors lodged a formal appeal _______ the ruling.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Lodge something (with somebody) (against somebody) যথাযথ কর্তৃপক্ষকে জানানো।
They wanted to lodge a complaint against him with the authorities.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৪) Wilson craved ______ family life.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Crave (for) ব্যাকুলভাবে কামনা করা; ব্যাকুল ইচ্ছে জাগা।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৫) They root for the hero, exult ____ his successes, are anxious for his triumph, and suffer at his reversals.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Exult at/in one’s success: অতিশয় আনন্দ করা বা উল্লসিত হওয়া।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৬) The police tried to blame the accident _______ the bus driver.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Blame something on: Assign the responsibility for a bad or unfortunate situation or phenomenon to (someone or something).
They blame youth crime on unemployment.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৭) Find out the parts of speech of the word: Ouch-
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Ouch (interjection) আকস্মিক ব্যথা প্রকাশধ্বনি।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৮) The girl was reclining _______ the couch.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Recline (Verb transitive), (verb intransitive) এগিয়ে দেওয়া/পড়া; হেলান দেওয়া; সটান শুয়ে পড়া: recline on a couch.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৩৯) Oh pooh! Don't be such a spoilsport. Here, ‘pooh’ is a/an-
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Pooh (interjection) অসহিষ্ণুতা, অবজ্ঞা বা দুর্গন্ধের দরুন ঘৃণা প্রকাশ করে; থু; উহ!

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪০) He went to market ______ taxi.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Bike, boat, bus, plane, train, car, taxi ইত্যাদির পূর্বে by বসে। তবে এদের পূর্বে Determiner থাকলে on বসে। ব্যতিক্রম- car, taxi এর পূর্বে determiner থাকলে in বসে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪১) She sent me that ______ Christmas.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: For- কারণে; হেতু; জন্য; দরুন।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪২) It is not difficult to see why Edward is enamoured _____ her.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Be enamoured of মুগ্ধ/অনুরক্ত হওয়া; প্রেমমুগ্ধ হওয়া: He is enamoured of her beauty.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৩) Our path is beset _______ difficulties.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Beset (verb transitive) চারদিক থেকে অবরোধ বা ঘেরাও করা।
The disaster has beset us with grave difficulties.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৪) 'There was a small reception following the wedding. The word 'following' in the sentence above is a/an _____.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Following (PREPOSITION) Coming after or as a result of.
Police are hunting for two men following a spate of robberies in the area.
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৫) He will have one more chance to atone _______ his failure in the final of the triangular series against Sri Lanka on Tuesday.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Atone (for) শোধরানো; প্রতিকার করা; প্রায়শ্চিত্ত করা: atone (for) an offence by doing something.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৬) And I've seen in many countries terrorists and resistance groups try to set up events to coincide _____ various high points in the calendar.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Coincide (with) অধিকৃত স্থান বা রূপরেখার দিক থেকে মিলে যাওয়া।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৭) I will watch while you sleep. Here, ‘while’ is-
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: “I will watch” এবং “you sleep” দুইটি বাক্য Conjunction “while” দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৮) We must raise the level of research and weed _____ the poorest work.
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Weed out someone/something: to get rid of people or things that are not wanted.
The administration plans to weed out failed programs.

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৪৯) Bravo, you're improving! Here, Bravo is a/an-
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp: Bravo (interjection) (উৎসাহ দিতে) শাবাশ! চমৎকার! Well down! Excellent!

Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.question: ৫০) _____ didn’t she tell you?
Conjunction, Interjection, Preposition,.exp:
Beginning a sentence with a conjunction can also be a useful way of conveying surprise:
And are you really going?
But didn’t she tell you?
Source: Oxford Dictionary.
